description: Maintainer-side analysis of an incoming pull request: competing fix (other open PRs already fixing the same issue), prior claims by someone other than the PR author, missing required artifacts (changeset file, DCO sign-off, CLA status), and whether the author is a first-time contributor. Returns markdown ready to post as one PR comment plus structured findings. Reads a .greenlight-guard.json in the working directory for per-repo check toggles. Never posts anything. Call this from a GitHub Action or before reviewing an incoming PR.

pr_url.description: Full GitHub PR URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

name: guard_pr
